requirement: Implement ParallelMetricsAggregator with multiprocessing Value and Array, process-safe atomic locking, category boundary validation, and clean worker joining.
skeleton: ParallelMetricsAggregator class using multiprocessing.Value and Array.

rationale.teaches: Shared counters across processes with Value and Array updated under get_lock, bounds-checked category indexes, and worker joins before reading the totals.
rationale.why: A lost update under a race is probabilistic, so a fixture has to hammer the counter from several processes and check the exact total. Missing joins and missing bounds checks show up in the same run.

candidates.why_wrong: total_count is incremented without get_lock, so concurrent workers lose updates and the total comes up short.
category_counts is updated without its lock, so per-category totals are lost under contention.
Every non-zero category records a count of 0, so only category 0 ever accumulates.
Workers are never joined, so the metrics are read before the workers finish.
The category index is not bounds-checked, so an out-of-range index raises from inside the shared array instead of IndexError with a message.
